text.aria-label: Subtitle text 'Dot: capacity from the daily fit divided by its injected recovery ratio. Thin line: 95% interval from resampling 7-day blocks. Wide band: the bound B on the capacity from the misfit test. Dashed black line: range over the library of confound shapes at a flagged Primary. 8 directional Primary substations; 6 solar farms (A to F); season-years run September to August, and 2025/26 is labelled 2025.'
text.tspan: Dot: capacity from the daily fit divided by its injected recovery ratio. Thin line: 95%
interval from resampling 7-day blocks. Wide band: the bound B on the capacity from the
misfit test. Dashed black line: range over the library of confound shapes at a flagged
Primary. 8 directional Primary substations; 6 solar farms (A to F); season-years run
September to August, and 2025/26 is labelled 2025.
